slug: 2025-07-06 Home Affairs on launch of world-class new identity verification service and cost

facts.fact: Home Affairs says its relaunched verification service against the National Population Register went live on 1 July 2025, with the justice cluster (SASSA, SAPS, Justice) onboarded and three private-sector users already moved over.
Home Affairs says the service supports social grant payments (SASSA), policing and justice, banking and insurance, for government and private-sector users.
Home Affairs says the justice cluster alone processes over 180,000 transactions per day through the service, and one private user has processed over one million batch records.

note: Date is the statement's event date, 1 July 2025; the page is dated 2025-07-06.
